content: PanoRef coverage optimizer implementation review and validation. A detailed code review (span 000000–000003) rates the algorithm architecture 8/10 and search-mode correctness 7.5/10, but readiness for complex imported sets only 4/10. The review confirms deterministic area-proportional sampling, joint-pair search that ranks by bitset union with quality/contribution tie-breakers, and a coarse-to-fine engine (4,096 coarse, 256 candidates, 24,576 fine). It flags six blockers: (1) imported sets can yield zero legal candidates because clearance uses whole-object AABBs instead of actual geometry; (2) geometry representation (JS objects, 64-bit numbers, structured-clone into worker, per-triangle allocations) will not scale to multi-million-triangle imports; (3) geometry extraction still blocks the main thread before the worker starts; (4) the UI can rewrite origins of already-captured panoramas, which is conceptually wrong since images are not re-rendered from new positions; (5) reachableCoverage and combinedCoverage use different sample banks (coarse vs fine with seed+1), making reported efficiency mathematically inconsistent, and fixed-first omits the fixed origin from the reachable union; (6) fixed-first mode does not enforce minimumOriginSeparation. Additional refinements: the four-level refinement is a multiresolution neighborhood sample, not a true iterative refinement loop; local offsets can float between floors on sloped/multilevel sets; the optimizer and runtime shader use different quality rules (angle/texel vs distance-only blend), though the shader was later updated toward winner-takes-most weighting with a shared PROJECTED_FALLOFF = 6.0 constant. The reviewer recommends preserving the high-level design but requiring seven changes before merge: actual geometry clearance, typed-array/transferable geometry, extraction moved into the worker, removal of existing-panorama origin relocation, one common sample bank for reported metrics, enforced separation in fixed-first, and reprojection of local refinement candidates onto their floor. Test execution (panoref_evt_000934) ran unit/lint/build: 42 test files, 371 tests passed, lint (tsc --noEmit) and build (vite) both exited 0. End-to-end Playwright tests (panoref_evt_000952) ran 22 tests across desktop-chromium and phone-390, all passing in ~3.5 minutes, including coverage optimizer completion and projected occlusion export. A separate smoke run (panoref_evt_000953/000954) was initiated but its result is not yet present in the snapshot. Tool outputs also include a projected-style GLSL fragment snippet and blend-weight tests (panoref_evt_000923). No GitHub Actions CI runs are attached to the latest head, so the reported test suite has not been independently enforced in CI.
